series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

derived.$reason: 35 observed years are loaded, but Macao SAR, China is not listed as a Party to the Paris Agreement (UN Treaty Collection, XXVII-7-d), so no NDC target is held to measure the trend against.

statements.sentence: The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change continues to be implemented in the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China.

The Kyoto Protocol to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change shall not apply to the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China until the Government of China notifies otherwise."
On 28 June 1999, the Government of Portugal informed the Secretary-General the the Convention would also apply to Macao.

Subsequently, the Secretary-General received communications concerning the status of Macao from Portugal and China (see note 1 under “Portugal” and note 3 under “China” in the “Historical Information” section in the front matter of this volume.)
Upon resuming the exercise of sovereignty over Macao, China notified the Secretary-General that the Convention will also apply to the Macao Special Administrative Region.

In accordance with the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China and the Basic Law of the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China, the Government of the People’s Republic of China decides that the Agreement applies to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China.

finance_listing.$reason: The Green Climate Fund's project list, read on 2026-10-19 (372 projects of every status: 332 Under Implementation, 17 Approved, 9 Lapsed, 8 Completed, 6 Discontinued), names no project for Macao SAR, China. The Fund's Governing Instrument (paragraph 35, page 12) reads: "All developing country Parties to the Convention are eligible to receive resources from the Fund." The UN Treaty Collection (XXVII-7, page 5) prints, under China: "The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change continues to be implemented in the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China." The UN Treaty Collection (XXVII-7, page 5) prints, under China: "The Kyoto Protocol to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change shall not apply to the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China until the Government of China notifies otherwise."" The UN Treaty Collection (XXVII-7, page 5) prints, under China and Portugal: "On 28 June 1999, the Government of Portugal informed the Secretary-General the the Convention would also apply to Macao." The UN Treaty Collection (XXVII-7, page 5) prints, under China and Portugal: "Subsequently, the Secretary-General received communications concerning the status of Macao from Portugal and China (see note 1 under “Portugal” and note 3 under “China” in the “Historical Information” section in the front matter of this volume.)" The UN Treaty Collection (XXVII-7, page 6) prints, under China and Portugal: "Upon resuming the exercise of sovereignty over Macao, China notified the Secretary-General that the Convention will also apply to the Macao Special Administrative Region."

by_source.scope: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK)
Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID
Non-CO₂ greenhouse gases only (CH₄, N₂O, F-gases), AR5 GWP100, excluding LULUCF (EDGAR 2024). CO₂ is omitted for licence reasons, so this is not a national total.

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: The UN Treaty Collection does not list Macao SAR, China as a Party to the Paris Agreement; under China it prints: "In accordance with the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China and the Basic Law of the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China, the Government of the People’s Republic of China decides that the Agreement applies to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China." 46 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 2.3 MtCO₂e, DS-35 1.2 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but Macao SAR, China is not listed as a Party to the Paris Agreement (UN Treaty Collection, XXVII-7-d), so no NDC target is held to measure the trend against. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.24°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.78°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.

46 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35).
For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 2.3 MtCO₂e, DS-35 1.2 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them.

No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but Macao SAR, China is not listed as a Party to the Paris Agreement (UN Treaty Collection, XXVII-7-d), so no NDC target is held to measure the trend against.
Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.24°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.78°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
